newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading in the absence of buying interest, traders said.
"There is nothing to report today because the market has not moved because of the absence of buyers. There is no trading, no bid, no nothing," said one trader.

Traders said the weak market sentiment was largely caused by holidays in Singapore and Malaysia. The Indonesian market will also close on Thursday for the Buddhist Wesak holiday and will reopen on Friday.
Traders said August SIR20 offer prices were quoted at 47.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang, 47.75 fob Medan and Surabaya, 47.25 fob Padang and 47.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Offer prices hovered between 48.25 and 48.50 in those cities on Tuesday.
